environment: SLURM GPU cluster. The login node 'prime' is shared and only runs light commands (git, editing, squeue). All heavy work runs on compute nodes in the user's own SLURM jobs via 'srun --jobid=<id> --overlap'.
Each git worktree under ~/github/<org>/<repo>-<branch> has its own .venv; scratch output goes to ~/tmp.
allow: Running uv sync, uv run, pytest, torchrun and training/eval entrypoints inside the user's own SLURM jobs via 'srun --jobid=<id> --overlap', from the user's own worktrees, including 'bash -lc' wrappers, '&&' chains and output redirected to ~/tmp or the run directory.
Cancelling SLURM jobs the user created in this session with scancel.

Allocating whole compute nodes with 'salloc --no-shell --exclusive -p all --time=<walltime> -J <name>' once the user has approved the node count, walltime and purpose in the conversation, or has told the agent to take nodes.
